text: In the book's notation, the contrapositive of the implication P → Q is:
explanation: The book defines the contrapositive of P → Q as ¬Q → ¬P and states it is logically equivalent to the original. Q → P is the converse, which the book warns is NOT logically equivalent in general; ¬P → ¬Q is the inverse; and P ∧ ¬Q is the negation of the implication (¬(P → Q) ≡ P ∧ ¬Q), not its contrapositive.
